page.overview:
Who is Bog'Ruhx?

Bog'Ruhx was a male Dug and the head of the Ruhx clan on Malastare. He posted a bounty on the entire Bazurkah family, in a consecutive process, after Bazurkah insulted his kin. When a bounty was also on his head, he was killed by the bounty hunter Jango Fett who claimed the bounty.

Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide
